title: Deterministic precondition of a nondeterministic program
statement: Given a nondeterministic register program $A$, an oracle, a deterministic multitape Turing machine $D$, a state assignment for the oracle deciders, a bound $B$, an input string $x$, and a register configuration $a$, the predicate holds exactly when the deterministic precondition holds for the program obtained by resolving every nondeterministic choice as $0$, with the same oracle, machine, state assignment, bound, input, and configuration.
hypotheses_covered: state assignment for the oracle deciders
caveat: The snippet does not include the definitions of the deterministic precondition or the operation resolving choices as 0, so their precise mathematical content cannot be stated from the supplied ground truth.
